used.how: page_copy_many (PAGE_MULTI, native) is only given sp_stride-0 copies (the replay rotation); the sp_stride RoPE copies keep pages_of_pair / the Python route
wq_b's bank call is judged by rel vs fp64 + repeat + cache growth (not gated on bytes vs the stock call); brought the entry with its batching id so the cited id exists here
the test uploads the bank copy through bank.upload (host TILE conversion first), as the model does, so both copies hold the same bfp8 bytes
expected saving: wq_b at 160 rows is weight-read bound (config sweeps ~0), so only the bank layout's read time counts

missing: QB.1's wqb_bank_knobs fell back to the 256-row entry for any other row count: the bank path's fp32 partials (rows x 12 column tiles a core) overflow L1 at 640 / 1280 rows (2x4 / 2x2 at 5120); a per-box condition is needed (now tt/attention.wqb_bank_ok, DS41-406)
A dict.get(key, f'...{r[x]}') default is evaluated eagerly: a report line for a case without that key raised after every metric was recorded (the first gate run failed on the report only)

overseer.evidence: This step adds no program built per chunk value: wq_b has no per-chunk value (addresses are program-cache overrides; cache growth 0 on fresh buffers, native_cache_growth_wqb160 = 0); the embedding's server_start / server_valid are common runtime args outside the hash (native_cache_growth_emb5120 = 0 on new values) and the ids re-upload stays removed (the engine input is read in place, no ids tensor); the rotation's offsets are PAGE_MULTI runtime-arg slots (growth 0). The slice-based sites OV-57 lists (e.g. _ring_carry's ttnn.slice, attention.py) are unchanged by this step; NC.9's carry fusion has no counterpart here (BREADCRUMBS MB.QB).
